gloss: to accelerate; to speed up; to gain momentum

definitions.gloss: to accelerate; to speed up; to pick up speed
definitions.explanation: To increase in speed or rate of motion. Used for both physical movement and abstract processes becoming faster.

definitions.gloss: to gain momentum; to intensify; to escalate
definitions.explanation: For a trend, change, or process to become more rapid or intense over time.

⟦カーブ→カーブ：27529_kaabu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けて→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{加速|かそく}した。
examples.english: After coming out of the curve, I accelerated all at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦ロケット→ロケット：00353_roketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大気圏|たいきけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧さらに{加速|かそく}する⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{人口減少|じんこうげんしょう}→人口減少：24385_jinkougenshou⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{過疎化|かそか}→過疎化：05242_kasoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧さらに{加速|かそく}する⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It is predicted that depopulation of rural areas will further accelerate due to population decline.

notes:
Describes both physical acceleration and the intensification of trends or processes. The physical sense is common in transportation and physics contexts, while the figurative sense frequently appears in news and social commentary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{加速度|かそくど}→加速度：22139_kasokudo⟧: acceleration (physics term)
- ⟦{加速|かそく}→加速：00198_kasoku⟧⟦ペダル→ペダル：27069_pedaru⟧: accelerator pedal
- ⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{加速|かそく}する: change accelerates
- ⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{加速|かそく}させる: to accelerate growth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {速|はや}める: to hasten — more general, used for actions and schedules
- スピードアップ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to speed up — casual, often for work pace
- ⟦{促進|そくしん}する→促進する：19632_sokushinsuru⟧: to promote/facilitate — focuses on encouraging progress rather than raw speed
